observation: Fresh main validated currentRunId against the durable RunStore identity grammar, but historical cycles[] remained an untyped array even though every runtime-generated cycle record carries a runId. A tampered cycle ledger could therefore preserve impossible run references and corrupt mission traceability without failing at the mission read boundary.
changes: Require each durable cycle ledger entry to be an object with a runId matching the established RunStore identity grammar.
Publish that minimal cross-reference contract in Autonomous Mission v0.1 without constraining assessment payloads or future cycle metadata.
Add a focused durable-read regression for valid and impossible cycle run references.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: cycles[] accepted arbitrary values and arbitrary runId strings.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: cycle entries fail closed unless their runId follows ^run-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$, while additional cycle fields remain extensible.
verification.focused_regression_contract: New checked-in test covers a valid reference, uppercase-prefix/non-run/empty references, and malformed null entries.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle only binds an existing cycle-ledger reference to the already-established run identity grammar. It does not choose cycle-record assessment schema, append-only policy, or a new audit architecture.
